body:
## Project overview

RecallTrace helps inventory teams locate stock affected by a recall. A reviewer checks the product and lot codes against the notice, then IBM Db2 returns the matching stock by location. The trace keeps the source quotes with the results.

## Team information

Solo submission by [@onellio](https://github.com/onellio).

## IBM Db2 integration

The prototype runs IBM Db2 Community Edition in Podman and connects through `ibm_db`. Db2 stores the product and inventory tables. A prepared SQL join binds the reviewed product and lot codes and returns the matching quantities and locations.

Follow the setup instructions in `submissions/recalltrace/README.md`. Load the fictional sample, check the two selected lots and run the live lookup. The expected result is 44 units across three locations.

## Technology and AI

Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, LangChain, Ollama and IBM Granite 3.3 2B. Granite suggests product and lot codes from numbered lines. The app copies the original quotes and asks a person to confirm the scope before running the Db2 query.

## Demonstration

[Watch the RecallTrace demo](https://vimeo.com/1244598160?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci)

The local app and setup instructions are in `submissions/recalltrace/`. Screenshots include the sample lookup, the narrower 14-unit Brisbane result, and the notice that prompted manual review.
